Which testing framework do you want to use?
Which dev tools do you want to include? (multi-select)
Which design pattern do you want to follow?
The .opencode framework contains stale data from a previous project (CTT-180/181) that breaks validation. How should I handle these old files?

options.label: Delete stale data (Recommended)
options.description: Permanently remove 10 stale CTT metric files, agent-performance.json, 2 traces, the CTT-180 blocker, and ctt-jira-mapping.csv. The pack becomes clean and portable for the new project. agent-performance.json will regenerate on first run with a new schema added so validation passes.

options.label: Archive instead
options.description: Move the stale files to .opencode/archive/ctt-leftovers/ instead of deleting, so they're preserved but out of the way. Validation will pass because the validator only scans metrics/.

options.label: Keep everything
options.description: Only add the agent-performance schema mapping. The CTT files stay in place and validation will still fail on them.

$q = "D:\Opencode\.opencode\archive\stale-ctt-project"; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $q -Force | Out-Null; $files = @(); $files += Get-ChildItem "D:\Opencode\.opencode\metrics" -Filter "*ctt-18*" -File; $files += Get-ChildItem "D:\Opencode\.opencode\metrics" -Filter "*ctt-17*" -File; foreach ($f in $files) { Move-Item -LiteralPath $f.FullName -Destination $q -Force; Write-Output "archived: $($f.Name)" }; Write-Output "=== metrics dir now ==="; Get-ChildItem "D:\Opencode\.opencode\metrics" -File | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Name

$q = "D:\Opencode\.opencode\archive\stale-ctt-project"; $moved = @(); if (Test-Path "D:\Opencode\.opencode\shared-state\blockers.json") { Move-Item "D:\Opencode\.opencode\shared-state\blockers.json" -Destination $q -Force; $moved += "shared-state\blockers.json" }; if (Test-Path "D:\Opencode\.opencode\ctt-jira-mapping.csv") { Move-Item "D:\Opencode\.opencode\ctt-jira-mapping.csv" -Destination $q -Force; $moved += "ctt-jira-mapping.csv" }; if (Test-Path "D:\Opencode\.opencode\traces") { Get-ChildItem "D:\Opencode\.opencode\traces" -File | ForEach-Object { Move-Item $_.FullName -Destination $q -Force; $moved += "traces\$($_.Name)" } }; if ($moved.Count -eq 0) { Write-Output "nothing to move" } else { $moved | ForEach-Object { Write-Output "archived: $_" } }; Write-Output "=== traces dir ==="; if (Test-Path "D:\Opencode\.opencode\traces") { (Get-ChildItem "D:\Opencode\.opencode\traces").Count } else { "absent" }
